card.name: Spots just before a g-word or digit
card.fires_on: Short pieces such as 't in don't, a comma or 'and' in a list, or a digit inside a year or number. Also the start of 'granola'. These are places where the next piece is often a g-word or a digit.

modes.label: Digits in years and decimals
modes.description: A digit or decimal point partway through a year or number.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma or 'and' in a list of drug or chemical names.
modes.example: corticosteroids, danazol, diuretics, estrogens, glucagon<<,>> isoniazid, niacin,

modes.label: Contraction and gran-
modes.description: The 't of a contraction, or 'gran' at the start of granola.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are odd and mixed, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on small pieces inside years, lists and contractions, with no single clear theme.
